notes: GAAP. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds statement (p4) Total Governmental Funds column; debt_proceeds = proceeds from bond issuance 100,000,000 + lease financing 557,054; premium from bond issuance 2,544,126 in other_financing. Roll-forward 112,597,083 + 133,021,162 - 200,053,226 + 9,741,690 - 11,292,125 + 100,557,054 + 2,544,126 = 147,115,764 ties. ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet cash and investments 159,871,550 (p3); no beginning cash printed. Business-type from the proprietary statement (p6) Total column (Landfill, Stadium, Sewer); disbursements total 6,103,263 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses 5,427,459 + interest expense 675,804; receipts total = operating 5,800,280 + miscellaneous 101,886. Capital contribution (7,348) and loss on disposals (17,991) in business_type.other_financing (as FY2024); rolls forward 31,423,564 to 32,747,563. Proprietary cash flows from p7 Total column. No restatement printed. Taxes and Local kept unsplit (no breakdown that ties; Statement of Activities property taxes and assessments 75,115,155 is government-wide); Local printed under the Intergovernmental heading (as FY2023/FY2024). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) by Governmental / Business-type columns, totals from the Total column; zero lines (Restricted for post closure costs) omitted; balances. Detail: cash-basis budget schedules for General (pp8-9), Special Roads (p10), COVID American Recovery Plan (p11) and all nonmajor special revenue funds (p12: revenue and transfer lines printed only for all nonmajor funds together; expenditure rows are individual funds); lines with no actual (Payroll Accrual, E911 Sinking, Planning - Tiburon SID Sewer, Special Roads transfer out, ARPA State/Local) omitted. Nonmajor receipts/disbursements by fund (p13) not itemized to avoid double counting with p12. No business-type statement-column detail (as FY2023/FY2024). Read pages 1-13 of 13
